q: How has the unemployment benefit period for the unemployed developed since 1994?
appeared: It appeared in the November 2022 and November 2024 exams.

da.q: Hvordan har dagpengeperioden for arbejdsløse udviklet sig siden 1994?

learn.text: There have also been attempts to get more people into work by shortening the so-called unemployment benefit period, the dagpengeperiode, that is the period in which you can receive support as unemployed from an unemployment insurance fund, an A-kasse. In 1993 a limit of seven years was set for the unemployment benefit period, and it has been continuously reduced: in 1995 to five years, in 1998 to four years, and since 2010 it has been two years.

learn.text: If you are a member of the national church, folkekirken, you also typically pay about 1 percent church tax. Church tax is paid only by taxable members of the national church.
